blurb: Guests can take guided boat tours to explore the Cedar Keys National Wildlife Refuge, watch wildlife like dolphins and manatees, and learn about local history. Offerings include pet-friendly coastal tours, sunset cruises, fishing and scalloping charters, and shuttle services to nearby islands. Tours vary in duration and schedule depending on the season and weather.
extraNote: Tours operate daily or on scheduled dates, weather permitting

quotes.text: Fantastic experience. Very relaxing, exciting, and entertaining. You also learn a lot. My family and I had an excellent time. The Collins’ are great people who care about Cedar Key and their customers. The price is so reasonable. You get so much out of the trip, and forever memories! Thank you Captains Phil and Misti!

Had a great afternoon tour with these folks last Sunday! Super nice guys and very informative about the area - past AND present. Even though they really didn’t have anything to do with it, the weather was fantastic, water was like glass, and the dolphins were right by our sides! Local birds were pretty cool, too!
We had a great tour experience. Friendly staff from start to finish. Guide was knowledgeable with a mix of history and current islands info. A good balance of nature and human history.
